module: "Organizations" career debug tab. Two cheat entries: give a random reputation (-50 to 150) to about 30% of organizations (via career_modules_playerAttributes.addAttributes) and mark about 30% of delivery facilities as 'interacted'.
notes: The first entry also calls career_career.interactWithOrganization for each organization drawn.

drawDebugFunctions.desc: Draws the entries '> Give random reputation to 30% of organizations' and 'Interact with random facilities'.
